title: Uruguay: review of reforms, candombe, the dictatorship and Montevideo

items: I can review cause connectors, purpose phrases, *mediante*, *pasar a* and fixed prepositions on Uruguayan topics.
I can use the words for Batlle's reforms, candombe, the dictatorship, new laws and Montevideo life.
I can read about Uruguay and answer questions about what the texts say.
I can say how something was done in politics with *mediante* (review).
I can give reasons for the reforms of the 1900s with *debido a* and *a raíz de* (review).
I can say what a tradition or a decision is for with *con miras a* and *con el fin de* (review).
I can say what a policy went on to include with *pasar a* + infinitive (review).
I can describe getting used to life in Montevideo with *acostumbrarse a* and *darse cuenta de* (review).
